text: ②じょうげで　『バッグ』を　えらびます　③「どうぐ」ポケットに　いれてある　キズぐすり　を　えらびます。

structure.jp: ②じょうげで　『バッグ』を　えらびます
structure.en: ② select "Bag" with Up and Down

structure.jp: ③「どうぐ」ポケットに　いれてある　キズぐすり　を
structure.en: ③ the Potion that has been put in the "Items" pocket

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある after a verb says someone did it earlier and it is still that way. いれてある = 'has been put in'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: 「どうぐ」ポケットに　いれてある　キズぐすり
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing tells you which thing. ポケットに　いれてある　キズぐすり = 'the Potion that is in the pocket'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says you use it to do the action. じょうげで = 'with Up and Down'.
